status: Exploratory retrospective pilot on saved models. Fixed before any ladder outcome; original end-to-end and probe outcomes were already known.
models: All candidates of results/representation-bottlenecks/family-probes (95 models), reconstructed and verified by that bundle's frozen procedure

levels.L0: Best of RBF-SVM and logistic on the raw standardized input x
levels.L1: Same classical procedure on the coordinates supplied to the encoding
levels.L2: SVM with precomputed fidelity kernel |<psi(x)|psi(x')>|^2 of the final state, initial and trained
levels.L3: Logistic on all one- and two-local Pauli expectations of the final state, initial and trained
levels.L4: Logistic on the model's own readout features, initial and trained; end-to-end BA recorded
levels.L5: L4 procedure on readout features of 20 random initializations (seeds 10000+k)

fitting: Fit partition only; StandardScaler inside the pipeline; hyperparameters by 5-fold stratified inner CV on balanced accuracy (grouped by recording for EEG); one test evaluation
checks: local-Z (and ZZ) from extracted states equal the model's own readout features
readout of trained model reproduces saved test predictions
primary_descriptive: Headroom realized by training: (L4_trained - mean L5) / (L2 - mean L5), L2 at trained parameters
Rank of the trained L4 probe among the L5 random draws
interpretation: Descriptive pilot. Small fit sets (120 to 450) and overlapping draws; CIs from the later analysis step are conditional on these benchmarks.
